{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))
print("Sample of QA orders:", qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])"}
